# Deployed Projects & Case Studies
- HR Interview System: Applied AI Engineer & Full-Stack Architect (Nov 2025 – Apr 2026). Enterprise AI video & voice mock interview platform. Orchestrated OpenAI Whisper audio transcription, OpenAI TTS voice question synthesis, and GPT-4o rubric scoring with WebRTC recording. Reduced candidate screening time by 75% with 98.5% transcription accuracy.
- Medical Interview Bot: Applied AI Engineer & Clinical Integrator (Feb 2026 – Apr 2026). Specialized clinical mock interview and viva examination platform. Multi-instance CPT architecture allowing medical institutions to deploy specialty viva examiners. Ingests medical CVs and case documents (PDF, DOCX, Excel) to formulate differential diagnosis questions via GPT-5-Nano / GPT-4o-mini in under 2.4s.
- Mentoro (Study Mentor): Applied AI Engineer & Distributed Systems Architect (May 2026 – Jul 2026). Decoupled AI educational mentoring system. High-concurrency NestJS microservice backend with WordPress React SPA Question Player (drawing canvas & formula editor). Ingests PDFs, Word docs, and YouTube lecture transcripts to generate flashcards, quizzes, and automated rubric grading for student answers in under 8s.
- WP AI Tools Suite: Applied AI Engineer & Multi-Model Integrator (Feb 2026 – Apr 2026). Consolidated 6-in-1 enterprise AI productivity suite in WordPress: OpenAI Assistants API vector store search (RAG), Chat Completions, DALL-E 3 image generation, Whisper STT, TTS, and RunwayML video generation, with a three-tier token budget engine saving 40% in API costs.
- Flirtmetrics: Mobile Specialist & Flutter Lead. Rebuilt card gesture matchmaking widgets for isolated state listeners (60 FPS). Configured bidirection WebSockets and SQLite cache to drop message delivery latency from 8.2s to <200ms.
- Enterprise ERP Platform: Supply chain ledger developer. Built Node.js parallel rule state-approvals and Range Partitioning on PostgreSQL transaction ledgers, dropping discrepancies to <0.8% and order pipeline process from 4 days to <30m.
- National Environmental GIS Monitoring Platform (NEGMP): System Architect & Proposal Author. Designed a conceptual GIS monitoring platform proposal for a national 250M tree plantation program in Bangladesh. Authored a multi-layer proposal featuring NestJS, PostGIS, Next.js, and Google Earth Engine API.
